scope: P1 amendment for six frozen ObjC crate archives: every archive member mapped to a notice-evidence class. No K1 writes, Cargo execution, build, adoption, license selection, operational notices or approval.

method.coverage: All regular-file members of the six checksum-verified .crate archives.
method.rust: Classes inherited from g1-source-history (repo), g1-objc-notice-scope (combined legacy ranges) and g1-objc-notice-origins (16 post-removal files).
method.nonRust: Authored non-Rust members resolved to the pinned Git blob (Cargo.toml.orig -> Cargo.toml), blamed with -M -C; nonempty lines matched to an origin commit whose LICENSE.txt is the Steven MIT text or to a verified 757cd841 snapshot blame key.
method.cargoGenerated: .cargo_vcs_info.json, Cargo.lock and normalized Cargo.toml are cargo package outputs; normalized manifest follows the Cargo.toml.orig decision.
method.limits: Class is evidence routing, not a legal ruling. Line evidence is not authorship, ownership, substantiality or license compliance. Inclusion in a future artifact is not established.

assetAmendments.limit: Historical project MIT notice preservation candidate only; no claim of Steven authorship for every range, no relicensing, no completeness.

No complete notice text exists in evidence. Do not substitute the later 2026 Mads text, LICENSE.md declaration, contribution policy or a synthesized holder/year without an explicit reviewer decision or authoritative source.
OSS notice assets do not create SDK-derived redistribution rights; A1-A7 decisions required before these members can be distributed in source form.
